CustomField.description: The Created Date of the most recently created KYC record associated with this account, where the KYC Status field is "Validated". Populated by the flow "KYC SCR Create KYC from Account". This date refers only to individual members in a retail/personal context for KYCs performed within CRM. It does not include KYCs done in external systems (e.g. wealth systems like Dataphile), nor does it indicate KYCs done in a commercial context (e.g. for beneficial owners). CRM-6521.
CustomField.label: Retail KYC Date
